basic_profile.bio: SpaceCadet_42 is a passionate advocate for space exploration and technology, residing in Seattle, WA. By day, they work as a software engineer at a tech company, and by night, they dive into the world of homemade trading card games and engage in strategic discussions on ReinhardtMains. When not exploring the cosmos or coding, they enjoy tinkering with cars, particularly their Infiniti Q50. Currently single, they spend most evenings online from 8 PM to midnight, engaging with like-minded individuals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: SpaceCadet_42 holds a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington and has a deep passion for astronomy and automotive technology. Their expertise in software development and self-taught knowledge in car mechanics enables them to provide insightful contributions in technical discussions and automotive threads.
